_about: Sound outside the match engine's own crowd (Stage 7.2). mix: the starting volumes of the three sliders in the menu (0 to 1) and whether the sound starts muted. Crowd covers the match crowd and the office's room tone; effects the referee, the ball and the taps, knocks and rings; music the office radio. levels maps the old Off/Low/Medium/High setting onto the sliders for players who had it set.

ui._about: Made-in-code sounds (src/render/audio/synth.ts) and their gains. A tap sounds at most once per tapGapMs. The war-room clock ticks every tickMs. The press cameras fire shutterBurst clicks spread over shutterSpreadMs.

office._about: The office's sound. roomTone: the gain of the soft room air. crowd: on a home match week the match crowd's bed drifts in through the window, muffled below crowdLowpassHz. roomToneS is how long the made loop is.

radio._about: The office radio's songs, played in turn (CC0, from OpenGameArt; see CREDITS.md). The radio's sound goes through a small speaker: below highpassHz and above lowpassHz is cut. gapS of quiet between songs.
